7️⃣ LuckySeven

Two dice are rolled and you bet on whether the total will be under 7, exactly 7, or over 7. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Choose your bet: Under 7, Exactly 7, or Over 7.
  2. Two dice are rolled and summed.
  3. Under 7: total 2-6. Over 7: total 8-12. Exactly 7: total = 7.
  4. Exactly 7 pays the most but is hardest to hit (6/36 probability).
  5. Under and Over are ~15/36 each, so slightly better odds than 7.
